text: 1879. Edison invents the light bulb.
Nope. Not exactly.
Edison: the light bulb myth.
Electric light was already around.
In the early 1800s, Humphry Davy made arc lights.
Blindingly bright. Not for your living room.
Dozens of inventors tried to make a bulb.
In England, Joseph Swan showed one before Edison.
The problem? They burned out fast.
Edison's team tested thousands of materials.
Their carbon filament lasted much longer.
Later, bamboo bulbs lasted over 1,000 hours.
Edison also built the whole system.
Power stations. Wires. Meters.
And Swan? Edison sued him.
Then they teamed up instead.
Their company was called Ediswan.
Edison made the bulb practical. He didn't invent it.
Inventors of the light bulb: way more than one.
Anyway, here's Edison inventing the light bulb.
